commands:
set -eu

APP=/opt/citibike-dashboard
S3=s3://citi-bike-nyc-pipeline/scripts/dashboard
STAGE=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$STAGE"' EXIT

mkdir -p "$STAGE/pages"

aws s3 cp "$S3/bedrock_sql.py" \
  "$STAGE/bedrock_sql.py" --region us-east-2

aws s3 cp "$S3/pages/2_AI_SQL_Generator.py" \
  "$STAGE/pages/2_AI_SQL_Generator.py" --region us-east-2

python3 -m py_compile \
  "$STAGE/bedrock_sql.py" \
  "$STAGE/pages/2_AI_SQL_Generator.py"

BACKUP="$APP/backup-sql-repair-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$BACKUP/pages"

cp -p "$APP/bedrock_sql.py" "$BACKUP/"
cp -p "$APP/pages/2_AI_SQL_Generator.py" "$BACKUP/pages/"

install -m 644 "$STAGE/bedrock_sql.py" "$APP/bedrock_sql.py"
install -m 644 "$STAGE/pages/2_AI_SQL_Generator.py" \
  "$APP/pages/2_AI_SQL_Generator.py"

systemctl restart citibike-dashboard.service
systemctl is-active citibike-dashboard.service

echo "Deployment complete. Backup: $BACKUP"
